notes: Pre-specified before the run. Same estimators, seed formula, and isotropic noise as configs/recalibration.json, applied to eight public numeric binary tables. Calibrators are fit on clean training rows only. Contrasts of interest: logistic isotonic minus baseline (Brier and ROC-AUC), forest sigmoid minus baseline (Brier), logistic sigmoid minus baseline (Brier), at sigma 0 and sigma 1. The dataset name is not part of the seed. WDBC rows are checked against the primary recalibration file.
